body:
C05 (#46) author pass delivered as draft PR https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/pull/72 against `codex/existence-monograph`. It makes the OPE matching chain explicit with one label `Q_n`, via the reference-match dictionary and the new `prop:ope-match-assembly`, and adds the C05 ledger. For G06: producers were not located for the signed reference transitions or the triangular columns, nor for the local trials and the marked representation. The O(4) action on field levels also has no producer; C05 consumes it (`results/C05/findings.md` F2, F5). Independent C05 review is now needed. This is not a closure claim.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
